main_body: Large leafy tree canopy (several clumped foliage masses) on a thick trunk with root flare
top_band: Light green leaf clumps (lime highlights) at the top of each canopy cluster, rows ~0-14, shaded down into mid and dark greens; no distinct flat band, organic foliage volume
evidence: The organic canopy is built from rounded foliage clumps lit from above, with lime highlights on the upper surfaces and dark green shadow under each clump. The trunk and branches show through below the leaves, and the roots flare out at the base. It matches the Beodeul reference trees, which use the same construction. No receding side face, and it is not a flat elevation. For an organic tree this reads as correct 3/4.

style.evidence: The canopy carries about 5 green steps, from lime highlights through mid greens to deep dark green, built from clumped leaf shapes with per-clump highlights. The trunk and roots use a brown ramp with lighter streaks, and small leaf tufts sit at the roots. Outlines are dark green next to leaves and dark brown next to wood, not black. There are no large flat fills, and tile density matches the reference trees. It is very close to the Beodeul reference, in the same style as the right-hand reference tree.
